v: Human Computer story kosam vellithe konchem disappoint avvachu. But genius Shakuntala Devi vs normal family life angle worked well for me... Vidya + Sanya are terrific 🙏
e: Shakuntala Devi is less interested in explaining how its subject became a mathematical phenomenon than in exploring what happened when an extraordinary personality collided with the expectations of parents, husband and daughter. That choice may disappoint viewers seeking a conventional biopic, but Vidya Balan and Sanya Malhotra make the personal story strongly engaging.
body:
if you are watching this movie with an expectation of understanding the hardwork, Challanges faced and efforts put in by Shakuntala Devi to become the Humman Computer as we know her, then you are in for a great dissapointment!!!

But if you are in to understand the ups and downs that happen in the life of a Genius and her relationship with her normal parents, normal husband and normql daughter then you are in for a treat!!! and the director make sures to prepare you in the first scene itself _/\_

The movie very well protrays how many Geneius/sucessful persons though praised by millions of outsiders fail to get the same respect and love from their own. And in this aspect is more or less similar to “My Father Gandhi!!!”

Acting wise Vidya Balan has nailed it as usual with her effortless protrayel showcasing various emotions and has been very well supported by Sanya Malhotra with her terrific performance.

Amit Sadh and Jisshu Sengupta though had limited role but made their presence felt

PS : When all the Kangana’s and Tapsee’s are fighting over to take credit on who is the flag bearer for female centric movies….Vidya Balan has been the unsung hero’ine in this!!!

v: Patience compulsory 😄 Lucknow slang + sloooow pace first test chestayi... adjust ayyaka Amitabh vs Ayushmann landlord-tenant Tom & Jerry full fun.
e: Gulabo Sitabo asks the viewer to adjust to its deliberate pace and strongly local Lucknowi flavour before its pleasures begin to reveal themselves. Once that rhythm clicks, Amitabh Bachchan and Ayushmann Khurrana become two wonderfully petty pillars holding up a sharp landlord-versus-tenant comedy.
body:
You need patience and passion to watch this movie!!!! to start with the Lucknowi slang makes it very hard for large of audience to connect with whats happening on screen and the slooow naration tests the patience!!!!

if you can overcome that major hurdle then you are in for an excellent ride given by the combo of AB vs AK!!! Story wise its Landlord Vs Tenant which is a desi adoption of Tom vs Jerry…..with few genuine roasts _/\_

on screen the chars of Ayushman and Amitabh tried to overshadow each other but in actual AB and AK were supporting this plot as major pillars _/\_ and the best performances were a simple cake walk for them!!! Never seen AB in such a kammenaa avtar 😛

v: Simple story, zero drama-baazi, beautiful emotion 🙏 Sanjay Mishra makes you feel for all those familiar faces we’ve watched for years but never remembered by name. MUST WATCH.
e: Kaamyaab turns the invisible life of Hindi cinema’s character actors into a warm, bittersweet and remarkably restrained film. Sanjay Mishra carries the entire journey with ease, while Hardik Mehta resists melodrama and lets the final irony — that even the finest sidekick remains overshadowed by the hero — land naturally.
body:
@Netflix, if you are in game for non-commericial movie with simple story line and excellent performances this is a must watch!!!!

with around 1.5 hrs of duration this movie shows the true feelings of side kicks of our Bollywood who even after being in tons of movies go unnoticed and the age of social media memes gives them a hope when ppl recognize them due to their memes!!!

as usual Sanjay Mishra has done a terrific performance and carried the whole movie on his shoulders!!!! Director has not tried anything to put melodramatic and the story looks realistic in every sense including a very well written climax with bottom line, No matter how well a side kick performs or no matter how well the audience enjoys the side kicks acting he will be always over shadowed by the “HERO” _/\_

v: Basically a regular family love story... only the couple happens to be two men 😄 Neither hard-hitting nor laugh-riot, but it makes the relationship feel refreshingly normal.
e: Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan deliberately treats its same-sex romance like the most ordinary Bollywood family conflict possible. That simplicity is both its strength and limitation: the film never becomes a hard-hitting message drama or an all-out comedy, but Ayushmann, Jitendra and the ensemble make a still-taboo subject accessible without melodrama.
body:
MAN!!! is there any movie genere that Ayushman cant do with ease!!!!!

story and execution wise its a simple routine love story where the lead pair falls in love and their parents doesnt approve their love….in the second half one of the lead pair enters the house to impress their partners family and finally the family approvs their love in typical “Jaaa Simran jaaa….jii le apni zindagi” style!!! but the only difference being the homo-sexuality of the lead pair!!!!

The writer and director Hitesh Kewalya thought of keeping the whole Homo-sexuality angle very simple without any melodrama or over the top message dialogues!!! nor he has ensured to make the film an out and out family entertainer with comedy (like Dream Girl)….so the film neither becomes a message oriented one nor a comedy entertainer but falls some where in between!!!!

All the artists were at their best with good charaterizations which made the whole homo-sexuality part (which is still considered as a Taboo) look very simple and watchable even for “FAMILY” audience!!!!

dont expect much from the movie and you will like it…..All the Ayushman fans (including me) who thump their chests with the choice of his script selection have one more movie to brag about!!!!
